rows.grounds: fused compound: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula); internal sandhi visarga to r

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula together with the eight attainments of powers?
premises: The eight accomplishments are enumerated as part of this teaching.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
The goddess is addressed directly as the recipient of this instruction.
items.inference: The eight accomplishments and the attainment of powers together define the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation within the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is compressed and open to slight interpretive variation.
items.plain_english: And the eight accomplishments, along with the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
